title: Herbal Midnight Norwegian Cranberries Stew
description: A silky, herbal stew bursting with dried cranberries, apricots, and lingonberries, simmered in a pressure cooker for a midnight craving that feels like a sweet, comforting hug.
instructions: Wash and rinse all dried fruits to remove any excess salt or sugar.
Heat the olive oil in the pressure cooker on the sauté setting and add the diced onion; cook until translucent, about 2 minutes.
Add minced garlic, grated ginger, cinnamon, and cardamom; sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in the dried cranberries, apricots, and lingonberries, and cook for another 2 minutes to toast slightly.
Pour in the vegetable broth, orange juice, and maple syrup; stir to combine all ingredients.
Seal the pressure cooker lid and set to high pressure for 10 minutes; this ensures the stew reaches a safe internal temperature of 121 °C.
After the cooking time, allow a natural release for 5 minutes, then quick‑release any remaining pressure.
Open the lid, stir the stew, taste, and adjust seasoning with a pinch of salt or extra maple syrup if desired.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with fresh mint or a swirl of coconut cream for extra richness.
Enjoy your midnight Norwegian herbal cranberry stew!
